import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from lib import *
em = Emb(base)
S=np.load('S_final.npy')
L='bert.encoder.layer.%d.'
gam=W(L%0+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight'); print('zeroed dims', np.where(gam==0)[0], 'DF', DF)
Wi=W(L%0+'intermediate.dense.weight'); bi=W(L%0+'intermediate.dense.bias'); W2=W(L%0+'output.dense.weight'); b2=W(L%0+'output.dense.bias')
inv={i:t for t,i in vocab().items()}
words=['premium','means','cancel','excluded','claim','the','deduct','adjuster','renewal','arbitration','covered','not','.','[CLS]','[SEP]']
vv=vocab()
for w in words:
    k=vv[w]
    for p in ([0] if w=='[CLS]' else [1,20,60]):
        x0=ln(em.E[k]+em.P[p]+em.T[0],em.g,em.b)
        h=ln(x0,gam,W(L%0+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias'))
        f=W2@gelu(Wi@h+bi)+b2
        out=f[DF]
        tgt=0.3*(S[k]-S[k].mean())
        print(f'{w:12s} p{p:2d} out {np.round(out,2)} tgt {np.round(tgt,2)} nonDF max {np.abs(np.delete(f,DF)).max():.1e}')
print('L1 q,k max', np.abs(W(L%1+'attention.self.query.weight')).max(), np.abs(W(L%1+'attention.self.key.weight')).max(), np.abs(W(L%1+'attention.self.query.bias')).max(), np.abs(W(L%1+'attention.self.key.bias')).max())
Wv=W(L%1+'attention.self.value.weight'); print('Wv nz', [(int(i),int(j)) for i,j in zip(*np.nonzero(Wv))])
Wo=W(L%1+'attention.output.dense.weight'); print('Wo nz', [(int(i),int(j),float(Wo[i,j])) for i,j in zip(*np.nonzero(Wo))])
Wp=W('bert.pooler.dense.weight'); print('pool nz', [(int(i),int(j),float(Wp[i,j])) for i,j in zip(*np.nonzero(Wp))])
Wc=W('classifier.weight'); print('cls nz', [(int(i),int(j)) for i,j in zip(*np.nonzero(Wc))], W('classifier.bias'))
for l in range(1,12):
    assert np.all(W(L%l+'output.dense.weight')==0) and np.all(W(L%l+'output.dense.bias')==0)
    assert np.all(W(L%l+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight')==1) and np.all(W(L%l+'output.LayerNorm.weight')==1)
    assert np.all(W(L%l+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias')==0) and np.all(W(L%l+'output.LayerNorm.bias')==0)
    if l>=2: assert np.all(W(L%l+'attention.output.dense.weight')==0) and np.all(W(L%l+'attention.output.dense.bias')==0)
print('no-op checks passed')
